original: 「爺さま、どうだった？」「ぼちぼちね。でも、先生が『手を握ってください』って言ったらちゃんと握るらしいから、言われてることはわかるみたい。元気になってくれるといいんだけど」

en.text: "How's Grandpops?" "Not so good. But when the doctor told him to squeeze her hand, he seemed to do it, as if he understood what she told him. I hope he gets well soon."

"How was Grandpa?" "Not great. But apparently when his doctor asked him to grab their hand he held it quite firmly, so he seems to at least understand what is being said to him. I just wish he'd return to normal though."
